metadata.title: Riemannian hypermaps to complex space forms
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we propose the notion of a \textit{hypermap}, defined as a Riemannian map whose range distribution is tangent to a real hypersurface of a complex space form. This construction leads to a new direction in Riemannian map theory. We establish the fundamental Gauss and Codazzi equations for a hypermap and use them to investigate the extrinsic geometry of its range leaves. In particular, when the ambient complex space form is non-Euclidean, we prove that these leaves cannot be totally umbilical and that their shape operator fails to be parallel. We further incorporate the Hopf condition and define \textit{Hopf hypermap}, thereby obtaining the analog of Hopf hypersurfaces. We also examine the umbilical case and show that an umbilical hypermap cannot exist to a non-Euclidean complex space form. This motivates introducing the \textit{$\eta$-umbilical hypermap}, which broadens the class of examples for studying the interaction between the range geometry and the ambient complex structure. Finally, we analyze the principal curvatures associated with these hypermaps, including results on their multiplicities and constancy.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 定义值域分布切于复空间形式实超曲面的Riemannian map，建立Gauss和Codazzi方程，并研究值域叶的外在几何。
analysis.breakthrough: 在非欧氏复空间形式中排除全脐值域叶和平行形算子，引入Hopf及η-脐hypermap以组织主曲率的重数和常性结果。
analysis.limitations: 结论依赖hypermap定义中分布可积性、叶的维数及环境全纯曲率规范，摘要未列完整条件。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。第15页致谢为具名人士讨论。17页PDF完整提取，全文关键词语境和额外点写/拆行模型名及Danus检索未观察到生成式AI实际使用披露。

analysis.priorityReason: 提供子流形几何的新表述，主要结果的独立内容需同既有实超曲面定理比较。
